The unstable, partially purified B13 dioxygenase II in PMID697765 is another preparation. PDB 2AZQ/Q51433 is C-1 context, not a replacement for the deleted native pointer. Structured database annotations, separately scoped to their cited preparations: physiologically-relevant = true.

diff.after: Native negative regulation annotation for the adjacent MT1 CcaC trans-dienelactone activity, with direct primary support from PMID14617643. Native protein purified from 5-chlorosalicylate-grown MT1 was assayed by depletion of 50 micromolar trans-dienelactone at 280 nm. Inhibitor incubations used 5 milliunits/ml enzyme, 1 or 10 mM EDTA and 50 mM Tris-HCl at pH 7.5; Table 3 reports remaining activity relative to inhibitor-free controls. These observations are not transferred to the distinct 4-chloromuconolactone activity, SalC or PcaD, and normalized EDTA(4-) identity does not establish assay solution protonation.
